title: Mệnh Đề Quan Hệ & Câu Chẻ – Luyện Tập
summary: Bài tập và đề thi trắc nghiệm mệnh đề quan hệ và câu chẻ.

exerciseSets.title: Luyện Tập Mệnh Đề Quan Hệ Đề 1

exercises.question: The woman next to my door is going to spend a few weeks in Sweden........ her daughter lives.
exercises.explanation: Sweden là danh từ riêng chỉ nơi chốn, do đó cần dùng dấu phẩy và trạng từ quan hệ 'where' để chỉ nơi chốn.

exercises.question: I can't remember the name of the garage ....... we had the car repaired.
exercises.explanation: Garage là danh từ chỉ nơi chốn, 'where' thay thế cho 'in the garage'.

exercises.question: It was an awful experience. It was the worst thing ........ has ever happened to me.
exercises.explanation: Trong cấu trúc so sánh hơn nhất 'the worst thing', ta bắt buộc phải sử dụng đại từ quan hệ 'that'.

exercises.question: The party .... we went to last night was not very enjoyable.
exercises.explanation: Cả 'which' và 'that' đều có thể làm tân ngữ thay thế cho vật 'The party' khi giới từ 'to' đứng cuối mệnh đề phụ.

exercises.question: He likes to tell people about his problems. He will talk to .... will listen to him.
exercises.explanation: Sử dụng đại từ bất định 'whoever' (bất kỳ ai) đóng vai trò làm chủ ngữ cho mệnh đề phụ 'will listen to him'.

exercises.question: At the end of this month, scientists at the institute will conduct their AIDS research, the results of... will be published within 6 months.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc chỉ lượng: danh từ chỉ vật 'research' -> 'the results of which'.

exercises.question: The whole world is hoping for the time .......... a cure for cancer will be discovered.
exercises.explanation: Danh từ chỉ thời gian 'the time' -> dùng trạng từ quan hệ 'when'.

exercises.question: The physician's office usually has a laboratory …..a variety of medical tests can be done.
exercises.explanation: Danh từ chỉ nơi chốn 'laboratory' -> dùng trạng từ quan hệ 'where'.

exercises.question: In traditional medicine a healer is someone......... may use a combination of ritual and remedies to treat a sick person.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người 'someone' -> dùng đại từ quan hệ 'that' (do các phương án khác không phù hợp).

exercises.question: There are many languages used around the world today__ do not have a form of writing.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật số nhiều 'languages' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: There are five flights going to Chicago everyday. I don't care which one we take. We can take .......fits best with our schedule.
exercises.explanation: Sử dụng đại từ 'whichever' (bất cứ cái nào) chỉ sự lựa chọn trong số lượng giới hạn.

exercises.question: The company hired ten new employees, some of ... are well-trained.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc lượng từ chỉ người: 'some of whom'.

exercises.question: The boys ...... tennis over there are my new neighbors.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động đầy đủ: 'who are playing'.

exercises.question: Simon is the man _________ Mary loves.
exercises.explanation: Tân ngữ chỉ người 'the man' -> dùng đại từ quan hệ 'whom'.

exercises.question: Only one of the people _________ work in the company is qualified.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người số nhiều 'the people' -> dùng đại từ quan hệ 'who'.

exercises.question: She is the one _________ I told you about.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người 'the one' đóng vai trò tân ngữ của giới từ 'about' đứng cuối câu -> dùng 'who' hoặc 'whom/that/whoever' (với who/whom là phổ biến nhất).

exercises.question: The magazine _________ you lent me is interesting.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật 'The magazine' đóng vai trò tân ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: The boy _________ sat next to you is my friend.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'People invited are expected to...'.

exercises.question: We are using books _________ were printed last year.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật số nhiều 'books' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ ở thể bị động -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: The painting_________Ms. Wallace bought was very expensive.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật 'The painting' đóng vai trò tân ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: The homeless people_____story appeared in the paper last week have now found a place to live.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người 'The homeless people... whose story' (những người vô gia cư có câu chuyện được đăng tải).

exercises.question: Were the Wright brothers the ones __________built the first aeroplane?
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người có dạng xác định 'the ones' -> dùng 'that'.

exercises.question: I don't like stories________ have unhappy endings.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật số nhiều 'stories' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: The periodic table contains all the elements, ________ has a particular atomic weight and atomic number.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc lượng từ chỉ từng thành phần: 'each of which' (mỗi cái trong số chúng).

exercises.question: Ansel Adams was a landscape photographer ________ photographs of the western United States show nature on a grand scale.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người 'Ansel Adams... whose photographs' (những bức ảnh của ông ấy).

exercises.question: Jan didn't check she had enough petrol before she left, ____ was careless of her.
exercises.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ 'which' đứng sau dấu phẩy thay thế cho cả ý mệnh đề phía trước.

exercises.question: This is a town ________ many people live.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ nơi chốn: 'in which' (= where).

exercises.question: Julie, ________ is your sister, lives far away.
exercises.explanation: Danh từ riêng chỉ người 'Julie' bổ sung thông tin không giới hạn -> dùng ', who'.

exercises.question: I see some girls ________ are pretty.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người 'some girls' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ -> dùng 'who'.

exercises.question: Give back the money ________ you took.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật 'the money' đóng vai trò tân ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: He was killed by a man ________ friends we know.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người: 'a man whose friends we know' (người đàn ông mà bạn của ông ta chúng tôi quen).

exercises.question: He spoke to the messengers with ________ you were leaving.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'with whom'.

exercises.question: We captured a town ________ is in Spain.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật 'a town' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: The farmers ________ we saw were in the field.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người 'The farmers' đóng vai trò tân ngữ -> dùng 'whom'.

exercises.question: The women ________ I gave the money were glad.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'to whom'.

exercises.question: I know a boy ________ name is John.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người: 'a boy whose name is John'.

exercises.question: The man ________ you sent to the general has reported the victory.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người 'The man' đóng vai trò tân ngữ -> dùng 'whom'.

exercises.question: The people ________ courage you praised are now citizens.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người: 'whose courage' (những người mà lòng dũng cảm của họ).

exercises.question: Those towns ________ you were looking at in Gaul are small.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật số nhiều 'Those towns' đóng vai trò tân ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: This is the girl _________ I talked yesterday.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'about whom I talked yesterday'.

exerciseSets.title: Luyện Tập Mệnh Đề Quan Hệ Đề 2

exercises.question: I saw those slaves ________ had been led to the city.
exercises.explanation: Đáp án chính xác ngữ pháp.

exercises.question: You folks ________ live in farmhouses do not like the life of the city.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người 'You folks' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ -> dùng 'who'.

exercises.question: Behind the farmhouse there was a large garden,____ the farmer and his sons were working.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ chỉ nơi chốn + đại từ quan hệ chỉ vật: 'in which' (= where).

exercises.question: Did you see the men ___ I gave the money?
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'to whom'.

exercises.question: She sends me the book________ she________ two years ago.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật 'the book' làm tân ngữ và mệnh đề chia quá khứ đơn 'wrote' -> dùng 'which / wrote'.

exercises.question: The man ________ spoke to John is my brother.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người 'The man' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ -> dùng 'who'.

exercises.question: I must thank the man from _____ I got the present.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'from whom'.

exercises.question: It is a car ______ I bought last year.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật 'a car' đóng vai trò tân ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: He is the man _______ son is a doctor
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người: 'the man whose son is a doctor'.

exercises.question: The problems ______they are discussing at the meeting are very important.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật 'The problems' đóng vai trò tân ngữ -> có thể dùng 'which' hoặc lược bỏ đại từ quan hệ 'Ø'.

exercises.question: Michael told me about students _______have just got the scholarship.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người 'students' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ -> dùng 'who'.

exercises.question: The ring ______ is made of gold and diamond.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ vật làm tân ngữ và lược bỏ đại từ: 'the ring she is wearing'.

exercises.question: The house ______ is situated in the city centre.
exercises.explanation: Lược bỏ đại từ quan hệ và sử dụng mệnh đề xác định trực tiếp: 'The house we have just bought'.

exercises.question: I come from a city _______ is located in the southern part of the country.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật 'a city' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ -> có thể dùng 'which' hoặc 'that'.

exercises.question: The film about _____ they are talking is fantastic.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ vật: 'about which'.

exercises.question: That’s the woman to _______ Jim used to be married.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'to whom'.

exercises.question: He is the boy _______ is my best friend
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người 'the boy' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ -> có thể dùng 'who' hoặc 'that'.

exercises.question: I met a lot of new people at the party ________ names I can’t remember.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người số nhiều: 'whose names' (những người mà tên của họ).

exercises.question: I talked to a woman __________ car had broken down on the way to the party.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người: 'a woman whose car had broken down'.

exercises.question: Vicky, __________ name was missed off the list, wasn’t very pleased.
exercises.explanation: Danh từ riêng chỉ người 'Vicky' kèm sở hữu cách -> dùng ', whose'.

exercises.question: The picture was painted by Laura, ____________ is being shown in an exhibition.
exercises.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ 'which' đứng sau dấu phẩy bổ nghĩa cho toàn bộ mệnh đề chính phía trước.

exercises.question: The concert ___________ we are looking forward is next Saturday.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc giới từ đi kèm động từ: 'look forward to' -> dùng 'to which' hoặc 'which' khi giữ giới từ ở cuối.

exercises.question: I’ll see you near the post office ___________ we met the other day.
exercises.explanation: Trạng từ quan hệ chỉ nơi chốn: 'near the post office where we met'.

exercises.question: The success of shared holidays depends on __________ you shared it with.
exercises.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ làm tân ngữ sau giới từ 'with' -> dùng 'whom'.

exercises.question: Tom made a number of suggestions, most of ____ were very helpful.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc chỉ lượng đi với danh từ chỉ vật 'suggestions' -> 'most of which'.

exercises.question: Alaska __________ my brother lives, is the largest state in the United States.
exercises.explanation: Danh từ riêng chỉ địa danh 'Alaska' -> dùng ', where'.

exercises.question: Tell me the reason ____________ you were absent yesterday.
exercises.explanation: Từ chỉ lý do 'the reason' -> dùng trạng từ quan hệ 'why'.

exercises.question: There was a time __________ dinosaurs dominated the earth.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ thời gian 'a time' -> dùng trạng từ quan hệ 'when'.

exercises.question: The house in ________ I was born and grew up was destroyed in an earthquake ten years ago.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ chỉ vị trí + đại từ quan hệ chỉ vật: 'in which'.

exercises.question: Summer is the time of the year _________ the weather is the hottest.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ thời gian 'the time of the year' -> dùng trạng từ quan hệ 'when'.

exerciseSets.title: Luyện Tập Mệnh Đề Quan Hệ Đề 3

exercises.question: The first television picture ……. John Logie Baird transmitted on 25 November, 1905 was a boy …… worked in the office next to Baird's workroom in London.
exercises.explanation: Vế 1 dùng 'that' làm tân ngữ cho 'television picture', vế 2 dùng 'who' làm chủ ngữ chỉ người cho 'a boy'.

exercises.question: Joyce Bews, …….was born and grew up in Portsmouth on the south coast of England, ….. she still lives, was 100 last year.
exercises.explanation: Danh từ riêng chỉ người 'Joyce Bews' dùng 'who', tiền ngữ chỉ nơi chốn 'Portsmouth' dùng 'where'.

exercises.question: The old lady ……… we were travelling told us her life story.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc 'travel with somebody' -> dùng giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'with whom'.

exercises.question: She says the exam, ……… she took yesterday, was full of hard questions.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không giới hạn chỉ vật 'the exam' -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: I called my cousin, …….. is a mechanic, to fix my car, ….. was broken.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không giới hạn vế 1 chỉ người dùng 'who', vế 2 chỉ vật dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: My only blue tie, …….. Richard wants to wear, is really an expensive one.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không giới hạn bổ nghĩa cho tie chỉ vật -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: This is the village ……… my family and I lived for six year.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ vị trí: 'in which'.

exercises.question: She is a famous actress ……… everybody admires.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người đóng vai trò tân ngữ -> dùng 'whom'.

exercises.question: Justine, …….. parents live in Christchurch, has gone to Southampton.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người 'Justine... whose parents'.

exercises.question: The old building ……… was behind the local church fell down.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật 'The old building' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: This man studies biology. What do you call him?

options.text: hat do you call a man who studies biology?
hat do you call a man, who studies biology?
hat do you call a man studies biology?
hat do you call a man whom studies biology?

exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ người làm chủ ngữ hỏi về danh từ không xác định -> 'a man who studies biology?'.

exercises.question: Hemingway developed a very concise writing style. His name is well - known throughout the world.

options.text: emingway, his name is well - known throughout the world, developed a very concise writing style
emingway, whose is name well - known throughout the world, developed a very concise writing style
emingway, whose name is well - known throughout the world, developed a very concise writing style
emingway, who developed a very concise writing style, his name is well - known throughout the world

exercises.explanation: Kết hợp câu dùng sở hữu cách ', whose name is well-known throughout the world,'.

exercises.question: This is the battle field. The soldiers fought there.

options.text: his is the battle field which the soldiers fought
his is the battle field that the soldiers fought
his is the battle field where the soldiers fought there
his is the battle field where the soldiers fought

exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề chỉ địa điểm 'where the soldiers fought' (không giữ 'there' ở cuối).

exercises.question: He was born in 1983. There was a severe drought that year.

options.text: e was born in 1983 when there was a severe drought
e was born in 1983 when was there a severe drought
hen there was a severe drought in 1983 he was born
e was born in 1983, there was a severe drought when

exercises.explanation: Kết hợp câu chỉ mốc thời gian 'in 1983 when there was a severe drought'.

exercises.question: John Montagu was an English Earl. He invented the sandwich.

options.text: ohn Montagu, whose invented the sandwich, was an English Earl
ohn Montagu, who invented the sandwich, was an English Earl
ohn Montagu, that invented the sandwich, was an English Earl
ohn Montagu, invented the sandwich, was an English Earl

exercises.explanation: Kết hợp câu không giới hạn chỉ người: 'John Montagu, who invented the sandwich, was...'.

exercises.question: Flies, which come mostly in the summer, carry diseases.

options.text: lies, to come mostly in the summer, carry diseases
lies, come mostly in the summer, carry diseases
lies, coming mostly in the summer, carry diseases
lies, that come mostly in the summer, carry diseases

exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động bằng cụm Hiện tại phân từ: 'coming'.

exercises.question: There was a candle which burnt in the room.

options.text: here was a candle burning in the room
here was a candle burnt in the room
here was a candle to burn in the room
here was a candle to be burnt in the room

exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'There was a candle burning'.

exercises.question: I see a boy who is running in the street.

options.text: see a boy running in the street
see a boy to running in the street
see a boy to run in the street

exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động đang diễn diễn: 'a boy running'.

exercises.question: He drew from the bag a watch which had been given for his birthday.

options.text: e drew from the bag a watch given for his birthday
e drew from the bag a watch been given for his birthday
e drew from the bag a watch had given for his birthday
e drew from the bag a watch had been given for his birthday

exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'a watch given for his birthday'.

exercises.question: One of the drivers who was brought by Steward came over to me.

options.text: ne of the drivers that were brought by Steward came over to me
ne of the drivers was brought by Steward came over to me
ne of the drivers brought by Steward came over to me
ne of the drivers bring by Steward came over to me

exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'drivers brought by Steward'.

exercises.question: We are talking about the girl who used to be a Miss World.

options.text: he girl about whom we are talking used to be a Miss World
e hardly know a girl who used to be a Miss World
he girl who used to be a Miss World said that she knew you
e know the girl who used to be a Miss World

exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'The girl about whom we are talking'.

exercises.question: He told her about the book. He liked it best.

options.text: e told her about the book which he liked it best
e told her about the book which he liked best
e told her about the book whom he liked best
e told her about the book whose he liked best

exercises.explanation: Lựa chọn đại từ quan hệ chỉ vật làm tân ngữ thích hợp: 'which he liked best'.

exercises.question: The old man is working in this factory. I borrowed his bicycle yesterday.

options.text: he old man is working in this factory which I borrowed his bicycle yesterday
he old man whom is working in this factory I borrowed his bicycle yesterday
he old man whom I borrowed his bicycle yesterday is working in this factory
he old man whose bicycle I borrowed yesterday is working in this factory

exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người kết hợp câu: 'The old man whose bicycle I borrowed yesterday'.

exercises.question: This is my opinion. You can do nothing to change it.

options.text: ou can do nothing to change it my mind
here’s nothing you can do to change my mind
here’s nothing can be done except changing my mind
ou can do everything to change it my mind

exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ lược bỏ đại từ và 'there': 'nothing you can do to change my mind'.

exercises.question: The man is my teacher. I am grateful to him.

options.text: he man whom I grateful to him is my teacher
he man whom I am grateful to is my teacher
he man is my teacher who I am grateful
he man to him I am grateful is my teacher

exercises.explanation: Giới từ đứng cuối hoặc lược giới từ: 'The man whom I am grateful to is my teacher'.

exercises.question: Ngoc is friendly. We are talking about her.

options.text: goc, we are talking about, is friendly
goc, whom we are talking about, is friendly
goc, about her we are talking, is friendly
goc, whom we are talking, is friendly

exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không giới hạn chỉ người làm tân ngữ: 'Ngoc, whom we are talking about, is friendly'.

exercises.question: A pilot is a person who flies an aircraft.

options.text: person who called a pilot flies an aircraft
pilot is someone who flies an aircraft
person that flies an aircraft is called a pilot
oth B and C are correct

exercises.explanation: Cả B và C đều đúng ngữ nghĩa và ngữ pháp.

exercises.question: That is the student. I borrowed his book last week.

options.text: hat is the student I borrowed whose book last week
he student whose book I borrowed that is
hat is the student, whose book I borrowed last week
hat is the student whose book I borrowed last week

exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách kết hợp mệnh đề không giới hạn: 'That is the student whose book I borrowed last week'.

exercises.question: We like the computer. We bought it yesterday.

options.text: e like the computer which we bought it yesterday
e like the computer we bought which yesterday
e like the computer we bought yesterday
he computer we like we bought yesterday

exercises.explanation: Lược bỏ đại từ quan hệ chỉ vật làm tân ngữ: 'the computer we bought yesterday'.

exercises.question: Dr. Sales is the person____________

options.text: n whom I don’t have much confidence
hom I don’t have much confidence in him
n that I don’t have much confidence

exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc 'have confidence in somebody' -> giới từ + đại từ quan hệ: 'in whom I don't have much confidence'.

exerciseSets.title: Luyện Tập Mệnh Đề Quan Hệ Đề 4

exercises.question: There is a good restaurant ...seafood.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bằng cụm To-infinitive sau 'There is': 'a good restaurant to eat seafood'.

exercises.question: English is an important language …...
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc To-infinitive chỉ mục đích/yêu cầu bổ nghĩa cho danh từ: 'an important language to master'.

exercises.question: He read The Old Man and The Sea, a novel ......... by Ernest Hemingway.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'a novel written by Ernest Hemingway'.

exercises.question: The man... there is my brother
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'The man standing there is my brother'.

exercises.question: I like books ...by Nguyen Du.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'books written by Nguyen Du'.

exercises.question: This is the only student .... this exercise.
exercises.explanation: Sử dụng To-infinitive sau danh từ có 'the only' bổ nghĩa: 'the only student to do this exercise'.

exercises.question: A girl... at a pub has won a lottery.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'A girl working at a pub'.

exercises.question: The book ... is mine.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bằng cụm giới từ: 'The book on the table is mine'.

exercises.question: He is the only men ... this problem.
exercises.explanation: Dùng To-infinitive sau từ thứ tự/duy nhất: 'the only men to solve this problem'.

exercises.question: A woman .... told all her husband's personal secrets.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bằng cụm tính từ bổ nghĩa cho chủ ngữ: 'A woman angry at her husband'.

exercises.question: There are six letters ... today.
exercises.explanation: Dùng To-infinitive bị động sau 'There are': 'six letters to be written today'.

exercises.question: Today, the number of people ... from AlDs is finally decreasing.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'the number of people dying from AIDS'.

exercises.question: The man ... to Jane is handsome.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'The man talking to Jane'.

exercises.question: The ideas ... in that book are interesting
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'The ideas presented in that book'.

exercises.question: My grandmother, ..., never goes out of the house.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bằng cụm tính từ ghép đồng chủ ngữ: 'My grandmother, old and sick, never...'.

exercises.question: I was awakened by the sound of a laughter ... from the next room.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'sound of a laughter coming from...'.

exercises.question: A person ...in a shop is call a shop assistant.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'A person serving in a shop'.

exercises.question: The house ... now belongs to Mr. Jonh.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'The house built now belongs to Mr. John'.

exercises.question: The car ... on the street is broken.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'The car left on the street'.

exercises.question: The men … for you comes from Japan.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'The men waiting for you'.

exercises.question: The teacher punishes anyone....the rules.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'punishes anyone breaking the rules'.

exercises.question: The house ... in red is where John lives.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'The house painted in red'.

exercises.question: People ... are expected to be formally dressed for the occasion.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'People invited are expected to...'.

exercises.question: The woman _______next door is a famous singer.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'The woman living next door'.

exercises.question: The house ______ in the storm has now been rebuilt.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'The house destroyed in the storm'.

exercises.question: Tom was the last ______the classroom yesterday.
exercises.explanation: To-infinitive sau 'the last': 'the last to leave the classroom'.

exercises.question: Linda was the last student ______ at the oral exam.
exercises.explanation: To-infinitive bị động sau 'the last student': 'to be asked'.

exercises.question: 1. The people __________ for the bus in the rain are getting wet
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'The people waiting for the bus'.

exercises.question: I have a message for people __________ by the traffic chaos.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'people delayed by the traffic chaos'.

exercises.question: I live in a pleasant room ____________ the garden.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'a pleasant room overlooking the garden'.

exercises.question: Melanie was the only person __________ a letter of thanks.
exercises.explanation: To-infinitive sau 'the only person': 'the only person to write a letter'.

exercises.question: Sunday is the day on ___________ I am least busy.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ thời gian: 'Sunday is the day on which I am least busy'.

exercises.question: Do you know the man about ___________ they’re talking?
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'the man about whom they're talking'.

exercises.question: I don’t like people ___________ lose their tempers easily.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người làm chủ ngữ -> có thể dùng 'who' hoặc 'that'.

exercises.question: Genghis Khan, …… name means "very mighty ruler", was a Mongol emperor in the Middle Ages.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người không giới hạn: 'Genghis Khan, whose name means...'.

exercises.question: The children ……. sang at the Mayor's parade were from the local school.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người số nhiều làm chủ ngữ -> dùng 'who'.

exercises.question: Galileo, ….. published works proving that the Earth revolves around the Sun, continued his scientific experiments even when he went deaf and blind.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người làm chủ ngữ mệnh đề không giới hạn -> dùng 'who'.

exercises.question: The school programme ….. has been interrupted by revision tests requires a regular course study.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật làm chủ ngữ -> dùng 'that'.

exercises.question: Credit ……. is given in this semester requires approximately three hours of classroom work.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật làm chủ ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: Two courses ….. have the same subjects are in different times.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật số nhiều -> dùng 'that'.

exercises.question: You may enroll our course by e-mail …….. can be faster than other registration forms.
exercises.explanation: Đại từ quan hệ làm chủ ngữ mệnh đề không giới hạn chỉ vật -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: The girl …….. dress you admire has been working for an Egpo company since she left school.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người: 'The girl whose dress you admire'.

exercises.question: The young man ……… was released after the court was found innocent of all the charges against him.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người làm chủ ngữ -> dùng 'who'.

exercises.question: Is that the same film …….. we watched last year?
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật làm tân ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: The girl …….. I borrowed the dictionary asked me to use it carefully.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'the girl from whom I borrowed'.

exercises.question: The pupils ……. we took to the amusement park behaved themselves very well.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người làm tân ngữ -> dùng 'whom'.

exercises.question: Bournemouth,….we are going to visit next summer, is a real paradise for the retired.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật làm tân ngữ mệnh đề không giới hạn -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: Thatcher, ……. birthplace was above a shop in the small English town of Grantham, became Prime Minister of Britain four years after she had become the leader of the Conservative Party in 1975.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người mệnh đề không giới hạn: 'Thatcher, whose birthplace...'.

exercises.question: First jeans, ………. became fashionable for women after they saw them in Vogue magazine, were made by two Americans, Jacob Davis and Levi Strauss.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không giới hạn chỉ vật số nhiều làm chủ ngữ -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: Felix Hoffman, a 29-year-old chemist …… worked for the German company Bayer, invented the drug Aspirin in April 1879.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người làm chủ ngữ -> dùng 'who'.

exerciseSets.title: Thi Online: Mệnh Đề Quan Hệ Đề 1

exercises.question: The man to _______ we have just talked is the Director General
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'The man to whom we have just talked'.

exercises.question: As a famous person _ many children admire, it is important for her to act responsibly.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người làm tân ngữ -> dùng 'whom'.

exercises.explanation: To-infinitive sau 'the first person': 'the first person to enter the room'.

exercises.question: They tell me about the film ______ on TV last week.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật làm tân ngữ -> dùng 'which they watched'.

exercises.question: The girl _____ design had been chosen stepped to the platform to receive the award.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người: 'The girl whose design' (cô gái có thiết kế được chọn).

exercises.question: Do you know the person _________ next to you in the evening class?
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động đang diễn ra: 'person sitting next to you'.

exercises.question: The second bus, _______ didn’t stop either.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không giới hạn chỉ vật -> dùng ', which was full,'.

exercises.question: The police have just round the man and his car _______ were swept away during the heavy storm last week.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ hỗn hợp (man and his car) -> bắt buộc dùng 'that'.

exercises.question: My relative, _____ you met yesterday, is a talented pianist.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người làm tân ngữ mệnh đề không giới hạn -> dùng ', whom'.

exercises.question: A college is a public institution ______ higher education to young men and women.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'institution providing higher education'.

exercises.question: This is the hotel ______ rooms have a view of the sea.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ vật: 'the hotel whose rooms have a view'.

exercises.question: This is Henry, ________works for your father.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không giới hạn chỉ người làm chủ ngữ -> dùng ', who'.

exercises.question: The temperature________ takes place varies widely from material to material.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ vị trí của hành động: 'at which they melt'.

exercises.question: Near the White House is another famous landmark _______the Washington Monument.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'another famous landmark called...'.

exercises.question: I have three brother, ___________ are professional athletes.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc lượng từ chỉ người: 'two of whom are professional athletes'.

exercises.question: India is the country ____________ he spent the early year of his life.
exercises.explanation: Trạng từ quan hệ chỉ nơi chốn: 'India is the country where he spent...'.

exercises.question: _____ instructed me how to make a good preparation for a job interview.

options.text: ohn Robbins to that I spoke by telephone,
ohn Robbins, that I spoke by telephone,
ohn Robbins I spoke to by telephone,
ohn Robbins, whom I spoke to by telephone,

exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không giới hạn chỉ người làm tân ngữ của giới từ 'to': 'John Robbins, whom I spoke to by telephone,'.

exercises.question: Nothing _____ I do seems to please her
exercises.explanation: Sau đại từ phủ định 'Nothing' -> bắt buộc dùng 'that'.

exercises.question: The man _ under oath at court and was charged with perverting the course of justice.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ chủ động: 'The man lying under oath'.

exercises.question: Candles________from beeswax burn with a very clean flame.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'Candles made from beeswax'.

exercises.question: There used to be many centenarians on this island, ________ attracted twenty scientists going there last year.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề nối tiếp bổ nghĩa cho toàn bộ vế trước -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: The boy _____ family is poor is very intelligent.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người: 'The boy whose family is poor'.

exercises.question: The Eiffel Tower, _________ design was revolutionary at its time, is still a marvelous structure.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ vật mệnh đề không giới hạn: 'The Eiffel Tower, whose design...'.

exercises.question: It’s the best film __________ have ever been made about madness
exercises.explanation: Sau cấu trúc so sánh hơn nhất 'the best film' -> dùng 'that'.

exercises.question: Dr Sales is a person _______.

options.text: n that I don’t have much confidence
hom I don’t have much confidence
n whom I don’t have much confidence

exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc 'have confidence in' -> giới từ + đại từ quan hệ: 'in whom I don't have much confidence'.

exercises.question: The party __________we went to last night was not very enjoyable.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật làm tân ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: It wasn’t an awful experience. It was the worst thing ____has ever happened to me.
exercises.explanation: Trong cấu trúc 'It is/was... that' nhấn mạnh sự việc và sau 'the worst thing' -> dùng 'that'.

exercises.question: Stress,______ is a psychological problem, may lead to physical illness.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không giới hạn chỉ vật làm chủ ngữ -> dùng ', which is a psychological problem,'.

exercises.question: Tim has passed the exam, ______ is great news.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ nối tiếp bổ sung ý nghĩa cho cả mệnh đề đứng trước -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: The house _______ 40 years ago is still in good condition.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động trong quá khứ: 'The house built 40 years ago'.

exerciseSets.title: Thi Online: Mệnh Đề Quan Hệ Đề 2

exercises.question: Last week, our class went to Ha Long Bay for a picnic, ___ made us very happy then.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ nối tiếp bổ nghĩa cho cả sự việc Ha Long Bay picnic phía trước -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: The girls and the flowers _________ he painted were vivid.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ hỗn hợp chỉ người và vật (girls and flowers) -> bắt buộc dùng 'that'.

exercises.question: The man _________ designed the building is my father.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người làm chủ ngữ -> dùng 'who'.

exercises.question: Martin tried three new jackets, ________ fitted him.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc chỉ lượng phủ định cho vật số nhiều: 'none of which fitted him'.

exercises.question: The boy __ was speaking to your daughter is the captain of the football team.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người làm chủ ngữ -> dùng 'who'.

exercises.question: He decides to go and teach abroad, ___ will be an interesting experience for him.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề nối tiếp bổ nghĩa cho cả hành động quyết định đi dạy ở nước ngoài -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: Neil Amstrong, the first person ______ on the moon, reported that the surface was fine and powdery.
exercises.explanation: Dùng To-infinitive sau 'the first person': 'the first person to set foot'.

exercises.question: Early forms of life on Earth, _____ in the absence of oxygen, required elements such as sulfur instead.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ chỉ vật số nhiều trong quá khứ -> dùng 'which lived'.

exercises.question: Cameron, ____ directed "The Titanic", is one of the leading faces in Hollywood.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không giới hạn chỉ người làm chủ ngữ -> dùng ', who'.

exercises.question: We are talking about the writer _____ latest book is one of the best-sellers this year.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người: 'the writer whose latest book'.

exercises.question: It was a service ________I will be eternally grateful.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc 'grateful to somebody for something' -> 'to which' (ở đây là service -> to which).

exercises.question: That is a problem _____ the government is now dealing
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc 'deal with something' -> giới từ + đại từ quan hệ: 'with which'.

exercises.question: It was last night ________ Sue borrowed my bike.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc câu chẻ nhấn mạnh trạng ngữ thời gian: 'It was last night that Sue...'.

exercises.question: She was once bitten by a monkey,____ made her dislike monkeys for the rest of her life.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề nối tiếp bổ nghĩa cho cả việc bị khỉ cắn -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: Last week, our class went to Ha Long Bay for a picnic, ________ made us very happy then.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ nối tiếp chỉ sự việc phía trước -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: The last person ______ the room must turn off the lights.
exercises.explanation: Dùng To-infinitive sau 'the last person': 'the last person to leave the room'.

exercises.question: The philosopher _____________ theories I am writing went insane before he died.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người: 'The philosopher about whose theories I am writing' (nhà triết học có các lý thuyết mà tôi đang viết về).

exercises.question: An endangered species is a species.......is so small that it is in danger of extinction.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ vật 'a species' đóng vai trò chủ ngữ -> dùng 'which'.

exercises.question: Yuri Gagarin was the first person __________into space
exercises.explanation: Dùng To-infinitive sau 'the first person': 'the first person to travel into space'.

exercises.question: Is that the same film_____ we watched last year?
exercises.explanation: Sau 'the same film' -> dùng 'which' hoặc 'that'.

exercises.question: The children ____ sang at the Mayor’s parade were from the local school.
exercises.explanation: Tiền ngữ chỉ người số nhiều làm chủ ngữ -> dùng 'who'.

exercises.question: She’s the person with __________ I share the flat.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'the person with whom I share'.

exercises.question: The police questioned the woman _________ handbag was stolen.
exercises.explanation: Sở hữu cách chỉ người: 'the woman whose handbag was stolen'.

exercises.question: My bike, ____ I left at the gate, had disappeared.
exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ không giới hạn chỉ vật làm tân ngữ -> dùng ', which'.

exercises.question: Ms Young, to ____ many of her students are writing, is living happily and peacefully in Canada.
exercises.explanation: Giới từ + đại từ quan hệ chỉ người: 'Ms Young, to whom many of her students...'.

exercises.question: The picture _________ was beautiful.
exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc 'look at something' -> giới từ + đại từ quan hệ: 'at which she was looking'.

exercises.question: They had invited over one hundred guests, ________.

options.text: ot any of whom I knew
did not know any of whom

exercises.explanation: Cấu trúc chỉ lượng phủ định đi kèm người làm tân ngữ: 'none of whom I knew'.

exercises.question: We should participate in the movements_________ the natural environment.
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động chỉ mục đích: 'movements organized to conserve' (các phong trào được tổ chức để bảo tồn).

exercises.question: The medicine _______ had no effect at all.

options.text: he doctor gave it to me
hich the doctor gave it to me
hich given to me by the doctor

exercises.explanation: Mệnh đề quan hệ lược bỏ đại từ quan hệ chỉ vật làm tân ngữ: 'The medicine the doctor gave me'.

exercises.question: Florida, _____ the Sunshine State, attracts many tourists every year
exercises.explanation: Giản lược mệnh đề quan hệ bị động: 'Florida, known as the Sunshine State,'.
